name: Affliction
description: Imposes debilitating conditions on a target via a close attack. Choose conditions for each degree of failure (1st: dazed/entranced/fatigued/hindered/impaired/vulnerable; 2nd: compelled/defenseless/disabled/exhausted/immobile/prone/stunned; 3rd: asleep/controlled/incapacitated/paralyzed/transformed/unaware). Target resists with Fortitude or Will (chosen at acquisition). Higher degrees replace lower ones.

pt-BR.name: Aflição
pt-BR.description: Impõe condições debilitantes ao alvo por meio de um ataque corpo a corpo. Escolha condições para cada grau de falha (1º: atordoado/fascinado/fatigado/impedido/prejudicado/vulnerável; 2º: compelido/indefeso/debilitado/exausto/imóvel/derrubado/aturdido; 3º: adormecido/controlado/incapacitado/paralisado/transformado/inconsciente). O alvo resiste com Fortitude ou Vontade (escolhido na aquisição). Graus maiores substituem os menores.

longDescription: Affliction attacks a target with a close attack (ranged with Increased Range extra). The target resists with Fortitude or Will. Each degree of failure inflicts one of three conditions chosen at acquisition. 1st degree: Dazed, Entranced, Fatigued, Hindered, Impaired, or Vulnerable. 2nd degree: Compelled, Defenseless, Disabled, Exhausted, Immobile, Prone, or Stunned. 3rd degree: Asleep, Controlled, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Transformed, or Unaware. Conditions replace each other (not stack) as degrees worsen. The conditions at each degree must form a logical progression.

extras.name: Cumulative
extras.description: Cumulative Affliction: failed saves stack. Each failure adds a degree even after full recovery.
extras.longDescription: In a Cumulative Affliction, multiple failed resistance checks result in additional degrees of the condition, regardless of previous recovery. The target does not recover from prior degrees before new ones are applied.

pt-BR.name: Cumulativo
pt-BR.description: Aflição Cumulativa: falhas acumulam. Cada falha adiciona um grau mesmo após recuperação completa.
pt-BR.longDescription: Numa Aflição Cumulativa, múltiplas falhas nos testes de resistência resultam em graus adicionais da condição, independentemente de recuperação anterior.

extras.name: Extra Condition
extras.description: Add an additional condition option at one degree of the Affliction.
extras.longDescription: Each rank adds one additional condition option at any one degree of the Affliction. The attacker chooses which condition applies when the effect succeeds.

pt-BR.name: Condição Extra
pt-BR.description: Adiciona uma opção de condição extra em um grau da Aflição.
pt-BR.longDescription: Cada rank adiciona uma opção de condição extra em qualquer grau da Aflição. O atacante escolhe qual condição aplicar.

extras.name: Progressive
extras.description: Target loses one degree per round even after initial resistance success.
extras.longDescription: A Progressive Affliction worsens over time. Even if the target succeeds on their initial resistance check, they still worsen by one degree at the end of each round until they succeed on a resistance check or reach the maximum degree.

pt-BR.name: Progressivo
pt-BR.description: O alvo perde um grau por rodada mesmo após sucesso na resistência inicial.
pt-BR.longDescription: Uma Aflição Progressiva piora com o tempo. Mesmo que o alvo tenha sucesso no teste inicial, ainda piora um grau ao fim de cada rodada até ter sucesso ou atingir o grau máximo.

extras.name: Alternate Resistance
extras.description: Some Afflictions may be initially resisted by Dodge. Later resistance checks are typically still Fortitude or Will.
extras.longDescription: Some Afflictions may be initially resisted by Dodge, representing the need for quick reaction time or reflexes to avoid the effect. In this case, the later resistance checks to remove the Affliction's conditions are typically still based on Fortitude or Will. For example, a target might make a Dodge check to avoid a blinding light or spray of liquid, but a Fortitude check to eliminate the effect if the initial Dodge fails.

extras.name: Concentration
extras.description: Once you hit, so long as you take a standard action each turn to maintain, the target must make a new resistance check with no attack check required.
extras.longDescription: Once you have hit with a Concentration Affliction, so long as you continue to take a standard action each turn to maintain the effect, the target must make a new resistance check against it, with no attack check required.

flaws.name: Instant Recovery
flaws.description: Target recovers instantly after completing their resistance check.
flaws.longDescription: The target of an Instant Recovery Affliction recovers from all conditions as soon as they succeed on a resistance check, rather than waiting for the normal recovery time.

pt-BR.name: Recuperação Instantânea
pt-BR.description: O alvo se recupera instantaneamente após completar o teste de resistência.
pt-BR.longDescription: O alvo de uma Aflição com Recuperação Instantânea se recupera de todas as condições assim que tiver sucesso no teste de resistência.

flaws.name: Limited Degree
flaws.description: The Affliction only has one or two degrees instead of three.
flaws.longDescription: A Limited Degree Affliction inflicts conditions from only one (-2/rank) or two (-1/rank) degrees rather than three. Choose which degrees at acquisition.

pt-BR.name: Graus Limitados
pt-BR.description: A Aflição tem apenas um ou dois graus em vez de três.
pt-BR.longDescription: Uma Aflição com Graus Limitados inflige condições de apenas um (-2/rank) ou dois (-1/rank) graus. Escolha quais graus na aquisição.

name: Burrowing
description: You can burrow through the ground, leaving a tunnel behind if you choose. You move through soil and sand at a speed rank equal to your Burrowing rank minus 5. Hard clay reduces speed by an additional rank; solid rock reduces it by two additional ranks.

pt-BR.name: Escavação
pt-BR.description: Permite escavar pelo solo, deixando um túnel se desejar. Você se move através de terra e areia a uma velocidade igual ao rank de Escavação menos 5. Argila dura reduz a velocidade em um rank adicional; rocha sólida reduz em dois ranks adicionais.

longDescription: You can burrow through the ground, leaving a tunnel behind if you choose. You move through soil and sand at a speed rank equal to your Burrowing rank minus 5. Hard clay reduces speed by an additional rank; solid rock reduces it by two additional ranks.

extras.name: Penetrating
extras.description: Dig through super-hard materials.

pt-BR.name: Penetrante
pt-BR.description: Escava através de materiais super-duros.

extras.name: Ranged
extras.description: Create tunnels at a distance or grant to others at range.

pt-BR.name: À Distância
pt-BR.description: Cria túneis à distância ou concede o efeito a outros.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.description: Limited to specific materials (e.g., loose sand, snow).

pt-BR.name: Limitado
pt-BR.description: Limitado a materiais específicos.

name: Communication
description: You can communicate over a distance using a medium other than your voice. Choose a sense type as your medium (visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile, radio, or mental). Rank determines range: 1 = close (100 ft), 2 = 1 mile, 3 = statewide, 4 = worldwide, 5 = unlimited. Communication is language-dependent and point-to-point.

pt-BR.name: Comunicação
pt-BR.description: Permite comunicar-se à distância usando um meio diferente da voz. Escolha um tipo de sentido como meio (visual, auditivo, olfativo, tátil, rádio ou mental). O rank determina o alcance: 1 = perto (30 m), 2 = 1,5 km, 3 = estadual, 4 = mundial, 5 = ilimitado. A comunicação depende de idioma e é ponto a ponto.

longDescription: You can communicate over a distance using a medium other than your voice. Choose a sense type as your medium (visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile, radio, or mental). Rank determines range: 1 = close (100 ft), 2 = 1 mile, 3 = statewide, 4 = worldwide, 5 = unlimited. Communication is language-dependent and point-to-point.

extras.name: Area
extras.description: Broadcast omni-directionally to all receivers in range.

pt-BR.name: Área
pt-BR.description: Transmissão omnidirecional para todos no alcance.

extras.name: Dimensional
extras.description: Communicate across dimensional barriers.

pt-BR.name: Dimensional
pt-BR.description: Comunica-se através de barreiras dimensionais.

extras.name: Rapid
extras.description: Communication is 10x faster per rank.

pt-BR.name: Rápido
pt-BR.description: Comunicação 10x mais rápida por rank.

extras.name: Selective
extras.description: Choose specific receivers within an Area Communication.

pt-BR.name: Seletivo
pt-BR.description: Escolhe receptores específicos em uma Comunicação de Área.

extras.name: Subtle
extras.description: Encrypted (1 rank) or undetectable (2 ranks).

pt-BR.name: Sutil
pt-BR.description: Criptografado ou indetectável.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.description: Only members of a particular group.

pt-BR.name: Limitado
pt-BR.description: Apenas membros de um grupo específico.

name: Comprehend
description: You can comprehend different sorts of communication. Each rank allows one option: understand or speak to animals (2 ranks for both), understand or speak languages (2 for both, 3 for universal, +1 for reading), communicate with machines (2 ranks), objects (2 ranks), plants (2 ranks), or spirits (1-2 ranks).

pt-BR.name: Compreensão
pt-BR.description: Permite compreender diferentes formas de comunicação. Cada rank permite uma opção: entender ou falar com animais (2 ranks para ambos), entender ou falar idiomas (2 para ambos, 3 para universal, +1 para ler), comunicar-se com máquinas (2 ranks), objetos (2 ranks), plantas (2 ranks), ou espíritos (1-2 ranks).

longDescription: You can comprehend different sorts of communication. Each rank allows one option: understand or speak to animals (2 ranks for both), understand or speak languages (2 for both, 3 for universal, +1 for reading), communicate with machines (2 ranks), objects (2 ranks), plants (2 ranks), or spirits (1-2 ranks).

flaws.name: Type
flaws.description: Limited to a broad (-1) or narrow (-2) type of subject.

pt-BR.name: Tipo
pt-BR.description: Limitado a um tipo amplo ou restrito de alvo.

name: Concealment
description: You gain total concealment from a particular sense while active. Each additional rank gives concealment from another sense; two ranks cover an entire sense type. Visual concealment costs double (2 ranks for one visual sense, 4 for all visual). Cannot conceal from tactile senses (requires Insubstantial). Concealment 10 = total concealment from all non-tactile senses.

pt-BR.name: Camuflagem
pt-BR.description: Concede ocultação total de um sentido específico enquanto ativo. Cada rank adicional concede ocultação de outro sentido; dois ranks cobrem um tipo de sentido inteiro. Ocultação visual custa o dobro (2 ranks para um sentido visual, 4 para todos). Não é possível ocultar-se do tato (requer Insubstancial). Camuflagem 10 = ocultação total de todos os sentidos não-táteis.

longDescription: You gain total concealment from a particular sense while active. Each additional rank gives concealment from another sense; two ranks cover an entire sense type. Visual concealment costs double (2 ranks for one visual sense, 4 for all visual). Cannot conceal from tactile senses (requires Insubstantial). Concealment 10 = total concealment from all non-tactile senses.

extras.name: Affects Others
extras.description: Grant Concealment to others via touch.

pt-BR.name: Afeta Outros
pt-BR.description: Concede Camuflagem a outros por toque.

extras.name: Area
extras.description: Affects everything in the area.

pt-BR.name: Área
pt-BR.description: Afeta tudo na área.

extras.name: Attack
extras.description: Impose Concealment on others.

pt-BR.name: Ataque
pt-BR.description: Impõe Camuflagem a outros.

extras.name: Precise
extras.description: Vary Concealment from total to partial at will.

pt-BR.name: Preciso
pt-BR.description: Varia Camuflagem de total a parcial à vontade.

flaws.name: Blending
flaws.description: Only functions while moving slowly.

pt-BR.name: Mesclar
pt-BR.description: Funciona apenas se movendo devagar.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.description: Works only under certain conditions (e.g., in shadows).

pt-BR.name: Limitado
pt-BR.description: Funciona apenas sob certas condições.

flaws.name: Partial
flaws.description: Provides partial concealment (-2 to Perception).

pt-BR.name: Parcial
pt-BR.description: Concede camuflagem parcial.

flaws.name: Passive
flaws.description: Ends if you make an attack or effect check.

pt-BR.name: Passivo
pt-BR.description: Acaba se você fizer um ataque ou teste de efeito.

flaws.name: Resistible
flaws.description: Offers a resistance check for anyone looking for you.

pt-BR.name: Resistível
pt-BR.description: Oferece teste de resistência a quem procurar.

name: Create
description: You can form solid objects out of nowhere (solidified energy, hardened water, ice, stone, etc.). Create simple geometric shapes or common objects. Maximum volume rank and Toughness equal to your effect rank. Objects vanish when you stop maintaining. Can trap targets inside hollow objects (requires attack check vs. Dodge and Dodge resistance check vs. rank).

pt-BR.name: Criação
pt-BR.description: Permite criar objetos sólidos do nada (energia solidificada, água endurecida, gelo, pedra, etc.). Crie formas geométricas simples ou objetos comuns. Volume máximo e Resistência iguais ao rank do efeito. Os objetos desaparecem quando você para de mantê-los. Pode prender alvos dentro de objetos ocos (requer teste de ataque vs. Esquiva e teste de resistência de Esquiva vs. rank).

longDescription: You can form solid objects out of nowhere (solidified energy, hardened water, ice, stone, etc.). Create simple geometric shapes or common objects. Maximum volume rank and Toughness equal to your effect rank. Objects vanish when you stop maintaining. Can trap targets inside hollow objects (requires attack check vs. Dodge and Dodge resistance check vs. rank).

extras.name: Continuous
extras.description: Objects remain until destroyed, nullified, or dismissed.

pt-BR.name: Contínuo
pt-BR.description: Objetos permanecem até serem destruídos ou desfeitos.

extras.name: Impervious
extras.description: The object's Toughness is Impervious.

pt-BR.name: Impenetrável
pt-BR.description: A Resistência do objeto é Impenetrável.

extras.name: Innate
extras.description: Objects are real and cannot be nullified.

pt-BR.name: Inato
pt-BR.description: Objetos são reais e não podem ser anulados.

extras.name: Movable
extras.description: You can move your created objects (as Move Object).

pt-BR.name: Móvel
pt-BR.description: Você pode mover os objetos criados.

extras.name: Precise
extras.description: Create detailed objects and moving parts.

pt-BR.name: Preciso
pt-BR.description: Cria objetos detalhados e com partes móveis.

extras.name: Selective
extras.description: You can make objects selectively transparent to attacks or solid to some creatures.

pt-BR.name: Seletivo
pt-BR.description: Permite tornar objetos seletivamente sólidos ou transparentes.

extras.name: Stationary
extras.description: Objects hang immobile in the air.

pt-BR.name: Estacionário
pt-BR.description: Objetos ficam suspensos no ar.

extras.name: Subtle
extras.description: Objects look like real objects (1 rank) or are invisible (2 ranks).

pt-BR.name: Sutil
pt-BR.description: Objetos parecem reais ou são invisíveis.

extras.name: Tether
extras.description: You can exert your own Strength to move the objects.

pt-BR.name: Conexão
pt-BR.description: Permite usar sua própria Força para mover objetos.

flaws.name: Feedback
flaws.description: You suffer damage when your objects are damaged.

pt-BR.name: Retroalimentação
pt-BR.description: Você sofre dano quando os objetos são danificados.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.description: Objects cannot be dismissed or repaired.

pt-BR.name: Permanente
pt-BR.description: Objetos não podem ser desfeitos ou reparados.

flaws.name: Proportional
flaws.description: Volume rank + Toughness rank = Create rank.

pt-BR.name: Proporcional
pt-BR.description: Rank de Volume + Resistência = Rank do efeito.

name: Damage
description: You inflict damage on a target via a close attack. Target resists with Toughness vs. DC [rank + 15]. One degree: -1 penalty to further Toughness checks. Two degrees: dazed + -1 penalty. Three degrees: staggered + -1 penalty. Four degrees: incapacitated. Penalties are cumulative. Incapacitated targets failing again become dying, then dead. Can be Strength-based to add Strength ranks to damage.

pt-BR.name: Dano
pt-BR.description: Inflige dano ao alvo por meio de um ataque corpo a corpo. O alvo resiste com Resistência vs. CD [rank + 15]. Um grau: penalidade de -1 em testes de Resistência futuros. Dois graus: atordoado + penalidade -1. Três graus: cambaleante + penalidade -1. Quatro graus: incapacitado. Penalidades são cumulativas. Alvos incapacitados que falham novamente ficam morrendo, depois mortos. Pode ser baseado em Força para somar ranks de Força ao dano.

longDescription: You inflict damage on a target via a close attack. Target resists with Toughness vs. DC [rank + 15]. One degree: -1 penalty to further Toughness checks. Two degrees: dazed + -1 penalty. Three degrees: staggered + -1 penalty. Four degrees: incapacitated. Penalties are cumulative. Incapacitated targets failing again become dying, then dead. Can be Strength-based to add Strength ranks to damage.

name: Deflect
description: You can actively defend others by deflecting or diverting attacks at a distance. Use your Deflect rank in place of an active defense (minimum roll of 11 on 10 or less). -2 at medium range, -5 at long range. Does not work against area effects or perception range attacks, nor attacks targeting defenses other than Dodge or Parry. Limited by power level.

pt-BR.name: Deflexão
pt-BR.description: Permite defender ativamente outros personagens defletindo ou desviando ataques à distância. Use seu rank de Deflexão no lugar de uma defesa ativa (mínimo de 11 em rolagens de 10 ou menos). -2 em alcance médio, -5 em alcance longo. Não funciona contra efeitos de área ou ataques de alcance percepção, nem ataques que visem defesas diferentes de Esquiva ou Aparar. Limitado pelo nível de poder.

longDescription: You can actively defend others by deflecting or diverting attacks at a distance. Use your Deflect rank in place of an active defense (minimum roll of 11 on 10 or less). -2 at medium range, -5 at long range. Does not work against area effects or perception range attacks, nor attacks targeting defenses other than Dodge or Parry. Limited by power level.

extras.name: Reflect
extras.description: You can reflect attacks back at the attacker as a free action. First, you must successfully deflect the attack, then make a normal attack check using your own attack modifier to hit with the reflected attack. It has its normal effect if it hits.
extras.longDescription: You can reflect attacks back at the attacker as a free action. First, you must successfully deflect the attack, then make a normal attack check using your own attack modifier to hit with the reflected attack. It has its normal effect if it hits.

pt-BR.name: Refletir
pt-BR.description: Pode refletir ataques de volta ao atacante como uma ação livre. Primeiro, deve defletir o ataque com sucesso, depois fazer um teste de ataque normal usando seu próprio modificador de ataque para acertar com o ataque refletido. Tem seu efeito normal se acertar.

extras.name: Redirect
extras.description: You can redirect attacks you successfully deflect at any target within the attack's normal range, as Reflect. You must have the Reflect extra to take this one.
extras.longDescription: You can redirect attacks you successfully deflect at any target within the attack's normal range, as Reflect. You must have the Reflect extra to take this one.

pt-BR.name: Redirecionar
pt-BR.description: Pode redirecionar ataques que defletir com sucesso para qualquer alvo dentro do alcance normal do ataque, como Refletir. Deve ter o extra Refletir para usar este.

name: Elongation
description: You can elongate your body and limbs. Add effect rank to your normal size rank to determine elongation distance: 15 feet at rank 1, 30 at rank 2, up to 1,000 miles at rank 20. Can make close attacks at greater distance. Grants +1 bonus to grab checks per rank (limited by PL). Snapping back is a free action.

pt-BR.name: Alongamento
pt-BR.description: Permite alongar o corpo e os membros. Some o rank do efeito ao seu rank de tamanho normal para a distância de alongamento: 4,5 m no rank 1, 9 m no rank 2, até 1.600 km no rank 20. Pode fazer ataques corpo a corpo a distâncias maiores. Concede +1 nos testes de agarrar por rank (limitado pelo NP). Voltar ao normal é uma ação livre.

longDescription: You can elongate your body and limbs. Add effect rank to your normal size rank to determine elongation distance: 15 feet at rank 1, 30 at rank 2, up to 1,000 miles at rank 20. Can make close attacks at greater distance. Grants +1 bonus to grab checks per rank (limited by PL). Snapping back is a free action.

name: Enhanced Trait
description: You can temporarily improve one of your existing traits by its rank while active. Cost per rank equals the cost of the base trait being enhanced. Enhanced Trait is a power effect (not a natural trait) and can be combined with extra effort. Subject to power level limits: unenhanced rank must be below the limit by at least the enhancement amount.

pt-BR.name: Traço Aprimorado
pt-BR.description: Permite melhorar temporariamente um de seus traços existentes pelo valor do rank enquanto ativo. O custo por rank é igual ao custo do traço base aprimorado. Traço Aprimorado é um efeito de poder (não um traço natural) e pode ser combinado com esforço extra. Sujeito aos limites de nível de poder: o rank base deve estar abaixo do limite pelo menos pelo valor do aprimoramento.

longDescription: You can temporarily improve one of your existing traits by its rank while active. Cost per rank equals the cost of the base trait being enhanced. Enhanced Trait is a power effect (not a natural trait) and can be combined with extra effort. Subject to power level limits: unenhanced rank must be below the limit by at least the enhancement amount.

extras.name: Limited
extras.description: Enhanced Trait only works under certain conditions (Nighttime Only, While Angry, Underwater, etc.).
extras.longDescription: Your Enhanced Trait only works under certain conditions, such as Nighttime (or Daytime) Only, While Angry (or in another emotional state), Underwater (or in some other environment), and so forth. A limit that rarely comes into play—like losing your Enhanced Trait during a new moon—can be handled as a power loss complication.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.description: Enhanced Trait only works under certain conditions (Nighttime Only, While Angry, Underwater, etc.).
flaws.longDescription: Your Enhanced Trait only works under certain conditions, such as Nighttime (or Daytime) Only, While Angry (or in another emotional state), Underwater (or in some other environment), and so forth. A limit that rarely comes into play—like losing your Enhanced Trait during a new moon—can be handled as a power loss complication.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.description: Your Enhanced Trait is a permanent improvement. Cannot be turned on/off or improved by extra effort.
flaws.longDescription: At no change in cost, your Enhanced Trait may be a permanent improvement, rather than a sustained effect. The primary difference is that your permanent enhancement cannot be turned on and off and cannot be improved by extra effort, including using it to perform power stunts. There is no action to use a Permanent Enhanced Trait, as it is always active.

flaws.name: Reduced Trait
flaws.description: One or more of your traits is lowered while others are enhanced.
flaws.longDescription: One or more of your traits is lowered while others are enhanced. This flaw is worth as many points as the reduction in the affected trait(s). So, for example, if you lose Intellect while you gain in Strength, treat the value of the lost Intellect ranks as the value of the flaw. As with all flaws, the effect must still cost at least 1 power point.

name: Environment
description: You can change the environment in an area. Affects a 30-foot radius at rank 1, increasing one distance rank per additional rank. Options (1-2 pts/rank each): Cold (intense/extreme), Heat (intense/extreme), Impede Movement (reduce speed by 1-2 ranks), Light (reduce/eliminate darkness concealment), Visibility (-2 or -5 to Perception). Multiple effects stack or use Selective modifier.

pt-BR.name: Controle Ambiental
pt-BR.description: Permite alterar o ambiente em uma área. Afeta um raio de 9 m no rank 1, aumentando um rank de distância por rank adicional. Opções (1-2 pp/rank cada): Frio (intenso/extremo), Calor (intenso/extremo), Impedir Movimento (reduz velocidade em 1-2 ranks), Luz (reduz/elimina ocultação por escuridão), Visibilidade (-2 ou -5 em Percepção). Múltiplos efeitos se somam ou usam o modificador Seletivo.

longDescription: You can change the environment in an area. Affects a 30-foot radius at rank 1, increasing one distance rank per additional rank. Options (1-2 pts/rank each): Cold (intense/extreme), Heat (intense/extreme), Impede Movement (reduce speed by 1-2 ranks), Light (reduce/eliminate darkness concealment), Visibility (-2 or -5 to Perception). Multiple effects stack or use Selective modifier.

name: Extra Limbs
description: You have extra manipulative limbs (arms, tentacles, prehensile hair/tail). Each rank grants one extra limb. Provides benefits of Improved Grab (grab with some limbs, leave others free). Does not grant extra actions. Applying all limbs to a grab grants +1 circumstance bonus per rank (max +5). All limbs except dominant are off-hand.

pt-BR.name: Membros Extras
pt-BR.description: Você possui membros manipulativos extras (braços, tentáculos, cabelo/cauda preênsil). Cada rank concede um membro extra. Fornece os benefícios de Agarrar Aprimorado (agarrar com alguns membros, deixando outros livres). Não concede ações extras. Usar todos os membros em um agarrar concede +1 de bônus circunstancial por rank (máx. +5). Todos os membros exceto o dominante são mão-inábil.

longDescription: You have extra manipulative limbs (arms, tentacles, prehensile hair/tail). Each rank grants one extra limb. Provides benefits of Improved Grab (grab with some limbs, leave others free). Does not grant extra actions. Applying all limbs to a grab grants +1 circumstance bonus per rank (max +5). All limbs except dominant are off-hand.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.description: Your Extra Limbs are continuous duration, always present.
extras.longDescription: Your Extra Limbs have continuous duration, meaning they are always present and do not require concentration to maintain.

extras.name: Projection
extras.description: Your Extra Limbs can be projected at range.
extras.longDescription: Your Extra Limbs can be projected at range, allowing you to manipulate objects or attack from a distance.

extras.name: Sustained
extras.description: Your Extra Limbs require sustained concentration to maintain.
extras.longDescription: Your Extra Limbs require sustained concentration to maintain. This is the default duration for Extra Limbs.

flaws.name: Distracting
flaws.description: Using your Extra Limbs is distracting, making you vulnerable.
flaws.longDescription: Using your Extra Limbs is distracting, making you vulnerable (see the Vulnerable condition) while using them.

name: Feature
description: You have one or more minor features granting occasionally useful abilities (one per rank). Similar to the Benefit advantage but derived from powers. Examples: insulating fur, internal compartment, iron stomach, mimicry (+10 to Deception for sounds), quick change, temporal inertia. GM decides what qualifies.

pt-BR.name: Característica
pt-BR.description: Você possui uma ou mais características menores que concedem habilidades ocasionalmente úteis (uma por rank). Similar à vantagem Benefício, mas derivada de poderes. Exemplos: pelo isolante, compartimento interno, estômago de ferro, mimetismo (+10 em Enganação para sons), troca rápida, inércia temporal. O Mestre decide o que se qualifica.

longDescription: You have one or more minor features granting occasionally useful abilities (one per rank). Similar to the Benefit advantage but derived from powers. Examples: insulating fur, internal compartment, iron stomach, mimicry (+10 to Deception for sounds), quick change, temporal inertia. GM decides what qualifies.

name: Flight
description: You can fly through the air, including hovering in place. Your flight speed rank equals your effect rank. Common flaws include Gliding (limited by starting height), Levitation (vertical only), Platform (knocked off if you fail a resistance check), and Wings (can't fly if immobilized/restrained/bound).

pt-BR.name: Voo
pt-BR.description: Permite voar pelos ares, incluindo pairar no lugar. Sua velocidade de voo é igual ao rank do efeito. Falhas comuns incluem Planar (limitado pela altura inicial), Levitação (apenas vertical), Plataforma (derrubado se falhar resistência), e Asas (não pode voar se imobilizado/contido/amarrado).

longDescription: Flight allows the character to move through the air at a speed rank equal to its rank. Rank 0 = hovering only. Rank 1 = 2 mph, Rank 5 = 30 mph, Rank 10 = 1000 mph (supersonic), Rank 15 = orbital velocity, Rank 20 = FTL. Unlike movement powers, Flight allows full 3D movement. Using Flight in combat uses the move action.

extras.name: Aquatic
extras.description: You can move underwater as easily as in the air. Water speed = Flight rank - 2.
extras.longDescription: You can move underwater as easily as in the air. You have a water speed equal to your Flight rank, minus 2, subject to the usual rules for swimming. You can make Athletics checks to swim as routine checks. This power does not allow you to breathe underwater (for that see Immunity). This is the Swimming power as an Alternate Effect.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.description: Flight operates even when incapacitated. You remain hanging in the air or float safely down.
extras.longDescription: Continuous Flight operates even when the user is incapacitated or otherwise unable to sustain it. The user remains hanging in the air, maintaining relative position to the ground, if necessary. Alternately, the user might float safely down to the ground when unable to maintain Flight as a kind of "safety net," your choice when you apply the modifier.

extras.name: Subtle
extras.description: Reduces or eliminates flight traces (rush of air, jet roar, contrail). Completely Subtle = automatic silent movement.
extras.longDescription: The default Flight effect is noticeable, whether from the rush of air, the roar of jets, or a glowing contrail or aurora. This modifier reduces, and then eliminates, these traces. If your Flight is completely Subtle, you do not need to make Stealth checks to move silently while flying (you do so automatically), although you may still need to do so to avoid being seen or otherwise detected.

flaws.name: Gliding
flaws.description: You can only glide, not truly fly. You lose altitude each round unless soaring on a draft.
flaws.longDescription: With Gliding, you can move horizontally but must lose altitude each round. In updrafts you may maintain altitude. You cannot hover or fly upward without a strong wind.

pt-BR.name: Planador
pt-BR.description: Você só pode planar, não voar de verdade. Perde altitude por rodada.
pt-BR.longDescription: Com Planador, você se move horizontalmente mas deve perder altitude por rodada. Não pode pairar ou subir sem vento.

flaws.name: Levitation
flaws.description: You can only fly straight up or down, not move horizontally while airborne.
flaws.longDescription: Levitation allows vertical movement only. You can rise and hover, but cannot move horizontally under your own power while in the air.

pt-BR.name: Levitação
pt-BR.description: Você pode apenas voar para cima ou baixo, sem movimento horizontal no ar.
pt-BR.longDescription: Levitação permite apenas movimento vertical. Você pode subir e pairar, mas não se mover horizontalmente.

flaws.name: Wings
flaws.description: Flight requires functional wings. They take up your off-hand slot and can be damaged.
flaws.longDescription: Your flight requires wings. If the wings are grabbed, damaged, or you are in a space too small for them, you cannot fly. Wings are noticeable and take up the equivalent of an extra limb.

pt-BR.name: Asas
pt-BR.description: O voo exige asas funcionais. Elas podem ser agarradas ou danificadas.
pt-BR.longDescription: Seu voo exige asas. Se as asas forem agarradas, danificadas ou você estiver num espaço pequeno, não pode voar.

flaws.name: Concentration
flaws.description: You can fly, but can't do much else at the same time.
flaws.longDescription: Flight requiring concentration means you can fly, but can't do much else at the same time. You must maintain concentration to keep flying.

flaws.name: Distracting
flaws.description: You are not very maneuverable and therefore vulnerable while flying.
flaws.longDescription: You are not very maneuverable and therefore vulnerable while flying (see the Vulnerable condition). This represents poor control or difficulty maintaining flight.

flaws.name: Platform
flaws.description: Flight relies on a platform. If knocked off or grabbed from ground, you cannot fly until reactivated.
flaws.longDescription: Your Flight is reliant on some sort of platform on which you stand or sit. If you fail a resistance check while flying, or you are grabbed by someone standing on the ground, you're knocked or pulled off your platform and cannot fly. You can regain the use of your flying platform by reactivating your Flight effect on your next turn.

name: Growth
description: You can temporarily increase your size. Each rank adds +1 Strength and +1 Stamina, +1 mass rank. Every 2 ranks: +1 Intimidation. Every 8 ranks: +1 Speed. Each rank: -1 Stealth. Every 2 ranks: -1 Dodge and Parry. Every 4 ranks: +1 size rank. Growth modifiers are restricted by power level limits.

pt-BR.name: Crescimento
pt-BR.description: Permite aumentar temporariamente seu tamanho. Cada rank adiciona +1 Força e +1 Vigor, +1 rank de massa. A cada 2 ranks: +1 Intimidação. A cada 8 ranks: +1 Velocidade. Cada rank: -1 Furtividade. A cada 2 ranks: -1 Esquiva e Aparar. A cada 4 ranks: +1 rank de tamanho. Modificadores de Crescimento são restritos pelos limites de nível de poder.

longDescription: You can temporarily increase your size. Each rank adds +1 Strength and +1 Stamina, +1 mass rank. Every 2 ranks: +1 Intimidation. Every 8 ranks: +1 Speed. Each rank: -1 Stealth. Every 2 ranks: -1 Dodge and Parry. Every 4 ranks: +1 size rank. Growth modifiers are restricted by power level limits.

extras.name: Permanent
extras.description: Your Growth is permanent. You are always at your increased size.
extras.longDescription: Your Growth is permanent. You are always at your increased size and cannot return to normal size, although the effect can still be Nullified unless it is also Innate.

name: Healing
description: You can heal Damage conditions by touch with a DC 10 Healing check. Each degree of success heals one condition, starting from worst. If the subject is dying, highest degree stabilizes them. Failed check: must wait 1 minute or use extra effort. Also grants bonus equal to rank on resistance checks vs. disease/poison. Does not work on subjects without Stamina.

pt-BR.name: Cura
pt-BR.description: Permite curar condições de Dano por toque com um teste de Cura CD 10. Cada grau de sucesso cura uma condição, começando pela pior. Se o alvo estiver morrendo, o grau mais alto o estabiliza. Teste falho: deve esperar 1 minuto ou usar esforço extra. Também concede bônus igual ao rank em testes de resistência contra doenças/venenos. Não funciona em alvos sem Vigor.

longDescription: Healing restores lost damage and removes conditions. Each rank allows healing one damage condition (bruised, hurt, injured, wounded, staggered, incapacitated) or one non-lethal condition removed. Healing requires touch and a standard action. You can also restore incapacitated targets or remove lasting conditions. Healing does not work on yourself unless combined with Affects Others or a separate self-healing power.

extras.name: Persistent
extras.description: Healing works even on healthy subjects, granting temporary resistance bonuses.
extras.longDescription: A Persistent Healing effect can be used on subjects who are not incapacitated. It grants a temporary bonus to Toughness or other resistance equal to rank for the scene.

pt-BR.name: Persistente
pt-BR.description: A Cura funciona em personagens saudáveis, concedendo bônus de resistência temporários.
pt-BR.longDescription: Um efeito de Cura Persistente pode ser usado em alvos não-incapacitados, concedendo bônus temporário de Resistência igual ao rank pela cena.

extras.name: Restorative
extras.description: Can heal ability damage and restore lost abilities.
extras.longDescription: Restorative Healing can undo ability damage and restore abilities lost or nullified by powers, removing conditions like Weakened on trait scores.

pt-BR.name: Restaurativo
pt-BR.description: Pode curar dano de atributo e restaurar atributos perdidos.
pt-BR.longDescription: Cura Restaurativa pode desfazer dano de atributo e restaurar atributos perdidos ou anulados por poderes.

extras.name: Stabilize
extras.description: Can automatically stabilize a dying character without a skill check.
extras.longDescription: With Stabilize, you can automatically prevent a dying character from slipping further toward death without requiring a Treatment check, though this still requires the normal healing action.

pt-BR.name: Estabilizar
pt-BR.description: Pode estabilizar automaticamente um personagem morrendo sem teste de perícia.
pt-BR.longDescription: Com Estabilizar, você pode automaticamente evitar que um personagem morra sem exigir teste de Tratamento.

extras.name: Action
extras.description: Reduces the action required to use Healing. Cannot use more than once per turn.
extras.longDescription: This extra reduces the action required for you to use Healing. You cannot use Healing more than once per turn regardless. To heal multiple subjects at once, apply the Area modifier.

extras.name: Affects Objects
extras.description: Your Healing can also "heal" damage to non-living subjects.
extras.longDescription: Your Healing can also "heal" damage to non-living subjects. You make a Healing check against the subject's worst damage condition, as normal.

extras.name: Area
extras.description: Healing grants the same benefit to all subjects in the affected area.
extras.longDescription: Healing with this extra grants the same benefit to all subjects in the affected area. Area Empathic Healing is an unwise combination, as the healer takes on all of the damage conditions of the affected subjects at once!

extras.name: Energizing
extras.description: Can heal fatigued and exhausted conditions. DC 10: one degree for fatigued, two for exhausted. You take on the removed conditions.
extras.longDescription: You can heal the fatigued and exhausted conditions as well as damage conditions: DC 10, one degree of success for fatigued, two degrees of success for exhausted. However, you take on the removed conditions and cannot use Healing to eliminate your own fatigue (although you can still use hero points to recover from them). If the Healing check fails, you must wait the normal recovery time or use extra effort to try again.

extras.name: Perception
extras.description: Applied to Ranged Healing, does not require an attack check to "touch" the subject.
extras.longDescription: Applied to Ranged Healing, Perception Ranged Healing does not require an attack check to "touch" the subject. You must still be able to perceive the target.

extras.name: Ranged
extras.description: Ranged Healing requires an attack check to "touch" the subject.
extras.longDescription: Ranged Healing requires an attack check to "touch" the subject with the Healing effect. The GM may waive the check for a willing subject holding completely still, but the subject is defenseless that round, making it an unwise decision in the midst of combat.

extras.name: Resurrection
extras.description: Can restore life to the dead! DC 20 check if dead for fewer minutes than your rank.
extras.longDescription: You can restore life to the dead! If the subject has been dead for fewer minutes than your Healing rank, make a DC 20 Healing check. If successful, the patient's condition becomes incapacitated, as if just stabilized. If the check fails, you can only try again using extra effort.

extras.name: Selective
extras.description: Area Healing may have this extra, allowing you to choose who in the area does and does not gain the benefits.
extras.longDescription: Area Healing may have this extra, allowing you to choose who in the area does and does not gain the benefits.

flaws.name: Empathic
flaws.description: When you cure someone else of a condition, you acquire the condition yourself.
flaws.longDescription: When you successfully cure someone else of a condition, you acquire the condition yourself and must recover from it normally. You can use Healing and Regeneration to cure your own conditions. You can have the Resurrection modifier for Healing, but if you successfully use it, you die! This may not be as bad as it seems if you have Immortality, allowing you to return to life.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.description: Healing is limited in some way (One Type of Damage, Objects only, Others only, Self only).
flaws.longDescription: Examples of ways in which Healing may be Limited include: One Type of Damage (such as energy or bludgeoning damage), Objects (in conjunction with Affects Objects), Others (you can't use Healing on yourself), or Self (you can only use Healing on yourself).

flaws.name: Temporary
flaws.description: Benefits last one hour. Subject then regains any damage conditions you healed.
flaws.longDescription: The benefits of your Healing are temporary, lasting for one hour. The subject then regains any damage conditions you healed. These conditions stack with others the subject acquired since the initial healing, which may result in more severe damage or even death.

name: Illusion
description: You can create false sensory impressions. Cost varies: 1 pt/rank for one sense type, 2 for two, 3 for three, 4 for four, 5 for all (visual counts as two). Your rank determines DC for Insight resistance check (DC 10 + rank). Illusion volume rank equals effect rank. Illusions have no substance. Maintaining an active illusion is a standard action; static is a free action.

pt-BR.name: Ilusão
pt-BR.description: Permite criar falsas impressões sensoriais. Custo varia: 1 pp/rank para um tipo de sentido, 2 para dois, 3 para três, 4 para quatro, 5 para todos (visual conta como dois). Seu rank determina a CD do teste de resistência de Intuição (CD 10 + rank). Volume da ilusão igual ao rank do efeito. Ilusões não têm substância. Manter uma ilusão ativa é ação padrão; estática é ação livre.

longDescription: Illusion creates sensory phenomena that are not real. Each rank covers one sense. You choose which senses at acquisition. The observer suspects the illusion and makes a Will check (DC 10 + rank). Success means they recognize it as fake; failure means they believe it. Illusions have no substance—physical interaction reveals them unless Believable is applied. Visual illusions (sight) cost double ranks.

extras.name: Believable
extras.description: Illusory constructs can physically interact with the world.
extras.longDescription: A Believable Illusion is tangible: it can be touched, has weight, and leaves traces. Physical investigations (touching the illusion) do not automatically reveal it. Resistance checks are required even for physical interaction.

pt-BR.name: Crível
pt-BR.description: Construções ilusórias podem interagir fisicamente com o mundo.
pt-BR.longDescription: Uma Ilusão Crível é tangível: pode ser tocada, tem peso e deixa rastros. Interações físicas não revelam automaticamente a ilusão.

extras.name: Independent
extras.description: Active illusions only require a free action to maintain, rather than a standard action.
extras.longDescription: Your active illusions only require a free action to maintain, rather than a standard action. This allows you to maintain complex, moving illusions while still taking other actions.

extras.name: Selective
extras.description: You choose who perceives your Illusion and who doesn't.
extras.longDescription: You choose who perceives your Illusion and who doesn't. This allows you to create illusions visible only to specific targets.

flaws.name: Phantasm
flaws.description: The illusion only exists in the mind of one target.
flaws.longDescription: A Phantasm only exists in the mind of a single target chosen at use. It is invisible to everyone else. The target resists with Will vs. DC 10 + rank; failure means they fully believe the illusion.

pt-BR.name: Fantasma
pt-BR.description: A ilusão só existe na mente de um único alvo.
pt-BR.longDescription: Um Fantasma existe apenas na mente de um único alvo. É invisível para todos os outros. O alvo resiste com Vontade vs. CD 10 + rank.

flaws.name: Feedback
flaws.description: A successful damaging attack on one of your illusions causes you to suffer damage.
flaws.longDescription: Although Illusion does not have a physical "manifestation" per se, it can apply this flaw, in which case a successful damaging attack on one of your illusions causes you to suffer damage, using the guidelines given in the description of the Feedback flaw.

flaws.name: Limited to One Subject
flaws.description: Only a single subject at a time can perceive your Illusion.
flaws.longDescription: Only a single subject at a time can perceive your Illusion. This significantly limits the utility of the power.

flaws.name: Ranged
flaws.description: Illusion's range is reduced. Being able to perceive the affected area is important.
flaws.longDescription: It is left to the GM's discretion whether or not Illusion's range can be reduced at all, since being able to perceive the affected area is important in creating and directing the illusion. In order to solely alter your own appearance, see the Morph effect, possibly with the Resistible modifier.

flaws.name: Resistible
flaws.description: Illusions Resistible by Will (hallucinatory) or Fortitude (biochemical). Targets immune to the resistance are unaffected.
flaws.longDescription: Illusions Resistible by Will are typically hallucinatory effects projected into the target's mind. This flaw is commonly combined with Selective, so only the targets you choose perceive your illusions. Illusions Resistible by Fortitude may represent a hallucinatory drug or similar biochemical effect. As usual, targets immune to effects targeting the resistance are unaffected by the illusion as well. This resistance check is in addition to the usual Insight check.

name: Immortality
description: You can recover from death. Subtract your Immortality rank from time rank 19 (one month) to determine recovery time. So rank 11 = 30 minutes, rank 20 = start of each action round. When you recover, all damage conditions are removed, but you lose all accumulated hero points.

pt-BR.name: Imortalidade
pt-BR.description: Permite se recuperar da morte. Subtraia seu rank de Imortalidade do rank de tempo 19 (um mês) para determinar o tempo de recuperação. Rank 11 = 30 minutos, rank 20 = início de cada rodada de ação. Ao se recuperar, todas as condições de dano são removidas, mas você perde todos os pontos de herói acumulados.

longDescription: You can recover from death. Subtract your Immortality rank from time rank 19 (one month) to determine recovery time. So rank 11 = 30 minutes, rank 20 = start of each action round. When you recover, all damage conditions are removed, but you lose all accumulated hero points.

name: Immunity
description: You are immune to certain effects, automatically succeeding on resistance checks. Assign ranks to effects: 1 rank (aging, disease, poison, one environment, etc.), 2 ranks (critical hits, suffocation), 5 ranks (alteration, sensory Affliction, a Damage descriptor), 10 ranks (common descriptor, life support), 20 ranks (very common descriptor), 30 ranks (all Fortitude/Will effects), 80 ranks (all Toughness effects).

options.name: Alteration / Sensory Affliction / One Damage descriptor
All effects resisted by Fortitude or Will

pt-BR.name: Imunidade
pt-BR.description: Torna-se imune a certos efeitos, tendo sucesso automático em testes de resistência. Atribua ranks: 1 rank (envelhecimento, doença, veneno, um ambiente, etc.), 2 ranks (acertos críticos, sufocação), 5 ranks (alteração, Aflição sensorial, um descritor de Dano), 10 ranks (descritor comum, suporte vital), 20 ranks (descritor muito comum), 30 ranks (todos os efeitos de Fortitude/Vontade), 80 ranks (todos os efeitos de Resistência).

longDescription: Immunity provides complete protection against a specific hazard or effect. The cost is 1 rank per hazard if the immunity is broad: Immunity 1 = one specific effect; Immunity 5 = a category; Immunity 10 = all effects of a broad type; Immunity 80 = all environmental hazards. Common examples: Immunity 1 (disease), Immunity 10 (fire effects), Immunity 30 (Fortitude effects).

flaws.name: Half Effect
flaws.description: Immunity provides only half protection (resistance rather than immunity).
flaws.longDescription: With Half Effect, the Immunity only reduces the effect rather than granting complete protection. For damage, this means -half the rank in Toughness bonus; for conditions, a +5 bonus to resistance checks.

pt-BR.name: Metade do Efeito
pt-BR.description: A Imunidade fornece apenas metade da proteção (resistência em vez de imunidade).
pt-BR.longDescription: Com Metade do Efeito, a Imunidade apenas reduz o efeito. Para dano, bônus de Resistência = metade do rank; para condições, +5 nos testes de resistência.

name: Insubstantial
description: You can assume a less solid form. Rank 1 (Fluid): flow through any non-watertight opening, exert normal Strength. Rank 2 (Gaseous): no Strength, immune to physical Damage, flow through non-airtight openings. Rank 3 (Energy): no Strength, immune to physical Damage, pass through energy-permeable objects. Rank 4 (Incorporeal): pass through solid matter, immune to physical and energy Damage.

pt-BR.name: Insubstancial
pt-BR.description: Permite assumir uma forma menos sólida. Rank 1 (Fluido): flui por aberturas não estanques, exerce Força normal. Rank 2 (Gasoso): sem Força, imune a Dano físico, flui por aberturas não herméticas. Rank 3 (Energia): sem Força, imune a Dano físico, atravessa objetos permeáveis a energia. Rank 4 (Incorpóreo): atravessa matéria sólida, imune a Dano físico e energético.

longDescription: You can assume a less solid form. Rank 1 (Fluid): flow through any non-watertight opening, exert normal Strength. Rank 2 (Gaseous): no Strength, immune to physical Damage, flow through non-airtight openings. Rank 3 (Energy): no Strength, immune to physical Damage, pass through energy-permeable objects. Rank 4 (Incorporeal): pass through solid matter, immune to physical and energy Damage.

extras.name: Affects Corporeal
extras.description: Required for any effect that works on corporeal targets while you are incorporeal.
extras.longDescription: This extra is required for any effect that works on corporeal targets while you are incorporeal. See the Affects Corporeal extra description for details and cost.

extras.name: Affects Others
extras.description: Allows you to extend your Insubstantial effect to another character by touch.
extras.longDescription: This modifier allows you to extend your Insubstantial effect to another character by touch, taking them Insubstantial with you. If you ever withdraw the effect while someone is inside a solid object, see the effect's description for the unpleasant results.

extras.name: Attack
extras.description: Makes Insubstantial into a close range effect able to turn targets Insubstantial.
extras.longDescription: Applied to Insubstantial, this extra makes it into a close range effect able to turn targets Insubstantial. You must be able to physically touch the target to make an Insubstantial Attack, meaning it must have the Affects Corporeal modifier to use it while you are incorporeal. This modifier is most effective for ranks 2 through 4, since the victim loses some or all ability to interact with the physical world. The default resistance for an Insubstantial Attack is Dodge, although it can be Fortitude or Will, as best suits the effect's descriptors.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.description: Allows you to remain Insubstantial until you choose to return to corporeal form.
extras.longDescription: Extending the effect's duration to continuous allows you to remain Insubstantial until you choose to return to your corporeal form.

extras.name: Innate
extras.description: Your character's form is naturally or innately Insubstantial, particularly if the effect is permanent.
extras.longDescription: Use this modifier if your character's form is naturally or innately Insubstantial, particularly if the effect is permanent in duration.

extras.name: Precise
extras.description: Allows you to selectively make some portions of your body insubstantial while keeping others substantial.
extras.longDescription: This modifier allows you to selectively make some portions of your body insubstantial while keeping others substantial (or vice versa). This allows you to do things like reach through a wall, solidify your hand to pick up an object or tap someone on the shoulder (or punch them in the face), and become incorporeal again to withdraw it on the following round.

extras.name: Progressive
extras.description: You can assume lower ranked forms of Insubstantial, but must progress through them in order.
extras.longDescription: You can assume lower ranked forms of Insubstantial, but you must progress through them in order to reach the higher-ranked ones. For example if you have Progressive Insubstantial 3, you can assume fluid, gaseous, or energy forms, but to assume energy form, you must first progress through fluid and gaseous, becoming less and less substantial. Since you can only activate the effect once per turn, it takes you three turns to get there.

extras.name: Reaction
extras.description: Allows you to switch forms "reflexively" in response to hazards, even if it is not your turn.
extras.longDescription: Becoming Insubstantial is normally a free action, meaning you can't switch to an Insubstantial form when surprised or otherwise unable to take action. At the GM's option, applying the Action extra to use Insubstantial as a reaction allows you to switch forms "reflexively" in response to such hazards, even if it is not your turn.

extras.name: Subtle
extras.description: Makes your Insubstantial nature less noticeable to observers.
extras.longDescription: This extra makes your Insubstantial nature less noticeable to observers. Rank 1 requires a Perception check (DC 20) to detect that you are Insubstantial, while 2 ranks mean you look entirely normal in Insubstantial form (which may cause opponents to waste effort on you, not knowing you are immune to their attacks, for example).

flaws.name: Absent Strength
flaws.description: Applies only to rank 1 Insubstantial. Removes your effective Strength while in that form.
flaws.longDescription: This flaw applies only to rank 1 Insubstantial and removes your effective Strength while in that form, leaving you with limited ability to affect the physical world like the higher ranks of the effect.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.description: You are always Insubstantial; you cannot assume solid form.
flaws.longDescription: You are always Insubstantial; you cannot assume solid form, although your Insubstantial effect can still be Nullified unless it is also Innate.

name: Leaping
description: You can make prodigious leaps. Your Leaping rank minus 2 is the distance rank covered in a single standing jump: 15 feet at rank 1, 30 at rank 2, up to 1,000 miles at rank 20. You suffer no damage from landing within your maximum distance. Leap speed maxes out at rank 7 (~250 mph).

pt-BR.name: Salto
pt-BR.description: Permite dar saltos prodigiosos. Seu rank de Salto menos 2 é o rank de distância coberta em um salto parado: 4,5 m no rank 1, 9 m no rank 2, até 1.600 km no rank 20. Não sofre dano ao aterrissar dentro da distância máxima. A velocidade do salto tem máximo no rank 7 (~400 km/h).

longDescription: You can make prodigious leaps. Your Leaping rank minus 2 is the distance rank covered in a single standing jump: 15 feet at rank 1, 30 at rank 2, up to 1,000 miles at rank 20. You suffer no damage from landing within your maximum distance. Leap speed maxes out at rank 7 (~250 mph).

name: Luck Control
description: You can use hero points or Luck to affect others. Each rank provides one option: spend a hero point on another's behalf, bestow hero points to others, negate someone else's hero point/Luck/complication use, or force a re-roll taking the worse result. Target may spend a hero point to avoid the re-roll.

pt-BR.name: Controle da Sorte
pt-BR.description: Permite usar pontos de herói ou Sorte para afetar outros. Cada rank fornece uma opção: gastar um ponto de herói em benefício de outro, conceder pontos de herói a outros, negar o uso de ponto de herói/Sorte/complicação de alguém, ou forçar uma nova rolagem ficando com o pior resultado. O alvo pode gastar um ponto de herói para evitar a nova rolagem.

longDescription: You can use hero points or Luck to affect others. Each rank provides one option: spend a hero point on another's behalf, bestow hero points to others, negate someone else's hero point/Luck/complication use, or force a re-roll taking the worse result. Target may spend a hero point to avoid the re-roll.

name: Mind Reading
description: You can read another character's mind. Make an opposed effect check vs. target's Will. Degrees of success: 1 = surface thoughts (transcends language), 2 = personal thoughts (ask one question), 3 = memories (one per round), 4 = subconscious (repressed memories, hidden personalities). Target gets a new Will check (DC 10 + rank) each turn to shut you out.

pt-BR.name: Leitura Mental
pt-BR.description: Permite ler a mente de outro personagem. Faça um teste de efeito oposto vs. Vontade do alvo. Graus de sucesso: 1 = pensamentos superficiais (transcende idioma), 2 = pensamentos pessoais (faça uma pergunta), 3 = memórias (uma por rodada), 4 = subconsciente (memórias reprimidas, personalidades ocultas). O alvo faz um novo teste de Vontade (CD 10 + rank) a cada turno para bloquear.

longDescription: You can read another character's mind. Make an opposed effect check vs. target's Will. Degrees of success: 1 = surface thoughts (transcends language), 2 = personal thoughts (ask one question), 3 = memories (one per round), 4 = subconscious (repressed memories, hidden personalities). Target gets a new Will check (DC 10 + rank) each turn to shut you out.

extras.name: Cumulative
extras.description: Attempts are cumulative.

pt-BR.name: Cumulativo
pt-BR.description: Tentativas são cumulativas.

extras.name: Effortless
extras.description: Retrying after failure doesn't require extra effort.

pt-BR.name: Sem Esforço
pt-BR.description: Tentar novamente após falha não exige esforço extra.

extras.name: Sensory Link
extras.description: Perceive through the target's senses.

pt-BR.name: Elo Sensorial
pt-BR.description: Perceba através dos sentidos do alvo.

flaws.name: Feedback
flaws.description: Suffer damage when the target resists with a natural 20.

pt-BR.name: Retroalimentação
pt-BR.description: Sofra dano quando o alvo resiste com um 20 natural.

flaws.name: Limited to Surface Thoughts
flaws.description: Only read surface thoughts.

pt-BR.name: Limitado a Pensamentos Superficiais
pt-BR.description: Lê apenas pensamentos superficiais.

name: Morph
description: You can alter your appearance (cosmetic change only, no trait changes). Grants +20 to Deception checks for disguise. Rank 1: single other appearance. Rank 2: narrow group (people of your size/gender, one animal type). Rank 3: broad group (humanoids, animals, machines). Rank 4: any form of same mass.

pt-BR.name: Metamorfose
pt-BR.description: Permite alterar sua aparência (mudança cosmética apenas, sem alteração de traços). Concede +20 em testes de Enganação para disfarce. Rank 1: uma única outra aparência. Rank 2: grupo restrito (pessoas do seu tamanho/gênero, um tipo de animal). Rank 3: grupo amplo (humanoides, animais, máquinas). Rank 4: qualquer forma da mesma massa.

longDescription: You can alter your appearance (cosmetic change only, no trait changes). Grants +20 to Deception checks for disguise. Rank 1: single other appearance. Rank 2: narrow group (people of your size/gender, one animal type). Rank 3: broad group (humanoids, animals, machines). Rank 4: any form of same mass.

extras.name: Metamorph
extras.description: Gain a different set of traits for the form.

pt-BR.name: Metamorfo
pt-BR.description: Ganha um conjunto diferente de traços para a forma.

name: Move Object
description: You can move objects at a distance without touching them. Effective Strength equals your rank. Concentrate (move action) for +1 STR. Has no action/reaction. Cannot perform fine manipulation without Precise modifier. Objects thrown as attacks use power rank as Strength for damage. Can make disarm, grab, and trip attacks.

pt-BR.name: Mover Objetos
pt-BR.description: Permite mover objetos à distância sem tocá-los. Força efetiva igual ao seu rank. Concentre-se (ação de movimento) para +1 FOR. Não tem ação/reação. Não pode fazer manipulação fina sem o modificador Preciso. Objetos arremessados como ataques usam o rank do poder como Força para dano. Pode fazer ataques de desarmar, agarrar e derrubar.

longDescription: You can move objects at a distance without touching them. Effective Strength equals your rank. Concentrate (move action) for +1 STR. Has no action/reaction. Cannot perform fine manipulation without Precise modifier. Objects thrown as attacks use power rank as Strength for damage. Can make disarm, grab, and trip attacks.

extras.name: Damaging
extras.description: Use Move Object to inflict damage.

pt-BR.name: Causar Dano
pt-BR.description: Usa Mover Objetos para infligir dano.

extras.name: Perception
extras.description: Move anything you can see.

pt-BR.name: Percepção
pt-BR.description: Move qualquer coisa que possa ver.

flaws.name: Limited Direction
flaws.description: Only move in one direction.

pt-BR.name: Direção Limitada
pt-BR.description: Move apenas em uma direção.

name: Movement
description: You have a special form of movement. Each rank provides one option: Dimension Travel (1-3 ranks), Environmental Adaptation, Permeate (1-3 ranks), Safe Fall, Slithering, Space Travel (1-3 ranks), Sure-Footed, Swinging, Time Travel (1-3 ranks), Trackless, Wall-Crawling (1-2 ranks), or Water-Walking (1-2 ranks).

pt-BR.name: Movimento
pt-BR.description: Possui uma forma especial de movimento. Cada rank fornece uma opção: Viagem Dimensional (1-3 ranks), Adaptação Ambiental, Permear (1-3 ranks), Queda Segura, Deslizar, Viagem Espacial (1-3 ranks), Pé Firme, Balançar, Viagem no Tempo (1-3 ranks), Sem Rastro, Escalar Paredes (1-2 ranks), ou Andar sobre a Água (1-2 ranks).

longDescription: You have a special form of movement. Each rank provides one option: Dimension Travel (1-3 ranks), Environmental Adaptation, Permeate (1-3 ranks), Safe Fall, Slithering, Space Travel (1-3 ranks), Sure-Footed, Swinging, Time Travel (1-3 ranks), Trackless, Wall-Crawling (1-2 ranks), or Water-Walking (1-2 ranks).

name: Nullify
description: You can counter effects of a particular descriptor (fire, magic, mental, etc.). Make a ranged attack check, then an opposed check of Nullify rank vs. effect rank or target's Will (whichever is higher). Success: targeted effect turns off (can be reactivated). Two+ degrees of failure: extra effort required to retry in same scene. Cannot nullify innate effects.

pt-BR.name: Anulação
pt-BR.description: Permite anular efeitos de um descritor específico (fogo, magia, mental, etc.). Faça teste de ataque à distância, depois teste oposto de rank de Anulação vs. rank do efeito ou Vontade do alvo (o maior). Sucesso: efeito alvo é desativado (pode ser reativado). Dois+ graus de falha: esforço extra necessário para tentar novamente na cena. Não pode anular efeitos inatos.

longDescription: Nullify temporarily cancels powers with the chosen descriptor. It is a ranged attack requiring an attack check. The target resists with Will vs. DC [10 + rank]. If successful, the described powers within rank points of the Nullify rank are cancelled until the target succeeds on a Will check (free action each turn, DC = Nullify rank + 10 − margin of failure). Nullify only affects powers matching the chosen descriptor.

extras.name: Broad
extras.description: Nullify affects a broad category of powers rather than a single descriptor.
extras.longDescription: Broad Nullify affects all powers with any descriptor within a wide category (e.g., all mental powers, all elemental powers, all technology) rather than one specific descriptor.

pt-BR.name: Amplo
pt-BR.description: Anular afeta uma categoria ampla de poderes em vez de um único descritor.
pt-BR.longDescription: Anular Amplo afeta todos os poderes com qualquer descritor dentro de uma categoria larga (ex: todos os poderes mentais) em vez de um específico.

extras.name: Simultaneous
extras.description: Simultaneous Nullify can counter all effects of a particular descriptor (such as fire or magic) at once.
extras.longDescription: Simultaneous Nullify can counter all effects of a particular descriptor (such as fire or magic) at once.

pt-BR.name: Simultâneo
pt-BR.description: Anular Simultâneo pode anular todos os efeitos de um descritor específico (como fogo ou magia) de uma vez.

extras.name: Alternate Resistance
extras.description: Nullify may require a Fortitude rather than a Will check to represent an effect resisted by health and stamina rather than strength of will.
extras.longDescription: Nullify may require a Fortitude rather than a Will check to represent an effect resisted by health and stamina rather than strength of will.

pt-BR.name: Resistência Alternativa
pt-BR.description: Anular pode exigir um teste de Fortitude ao invés de Vontade para representar um efeito resistido por saúde e vigor ao invés de força de vontade.

extras.name: Area
extras.description: An Area Nullify effect works on all targets in the area. Make a single power check and compare the result against the opposed checks of the targets. Targets lacking effects you can nullify are, naturally, unaffected.
extras.longDescription: An Area Nullify effect works on all targets in the area. Make a single power check and compare the result against the opposed checks of the targets. Targets lacking effects you can nullify are, naturally, unaffected. If your Area Nullify has a duration longer than instant, choose whether or not the effect remains in the chosen area (affecting anyone entering or leaving it) or moves with the targets hit with the initial effect.

pt-BR.name: Área
pt-BR.description: Anular em Área funciona em todos os alvos na área. Faça um único teste de poder e compare o resultado contra os testes opostos dos alvos. Alvos sem efeitos que você possa anular não são afetados.

extras.name: Concentration
extras.description: Any countered effect is suppressed and cannot be re-activated while you concentrate. The user of the countered effect may use extra effort to gain another opposed Nullify check. If successful, the effect can be re-activated.
extras.longDescription: Any countered effect is suppressed and cannot be re-activated while you concentrate. The user of the countered effect may use extra effort to gain another opposed Nullify check. If successful, the effect can be re-activated.

pt-BR.name: Concentração
pt-BR.description: Qualquer efeito anulado é suprimido e não pode ser reativado enquanto você se concentra. O usuário do efeito anulado pode usar esforço extra para obter outro teste oposto de Anular.

extras.name: Effortless
extras.description: Trying again after two or more degrees of failure does not require extra effort for you. You can retry a Nullify attempt an unlimited number of times.
extras.longDescription: Trying again after two or more degrees of failure does not require extra effort for you. You can retry a Nullify attempt an unlimited number of times.

pt-BR.name: Sem Esforço
pt-BR.description: Tentar novamente após dois ou mais graus de falha não requer esforço extra. Você pode tentar Anular um número ilimitado de vezes.

extras.name: Precise
extras.description: If you can Nullify multiple effects, this modifier allows you to choose which are nullified and which are not.
extras.longDescription: If you can Nullify multiple effects, this modifier allows you to choose which are nullified and which are not.

pt-BR.name: Preciso
pt-BR.description: Se você pode Anular múltiplos efeitos, este modificador permite escolher quais são anulados e quais não são.

extras.name: Randomize
extras.description: Rather than being countered, the effect(s) targeted by your Nullify acquire the Uncontrolled flaw and go out of control (as dictated by the GM).
extras.longDescription: Rather than being countered, the effect(s) targeted by your Nullify acquire the Uncontrolled flaw and go out of control (as dictated by the GM).

pt-BR.name: Aleatorizar
pt-BR.description: Ao invés de ser anulado, o(s) efeito(s) alvo do seu Anular adquirem a falha Descontrolado e saem de controle (conforme ditado pelo Mestre).

extras.name: Selective
extras.description: If you have an Area Nullify effect, this extra allows you to choose who in the area is affected, nullifying some targets and not others.
extras.longDescription: If you have an Area Nullify effect, this extra allows you to choose who in the area is affected, nullifying some targets and not others.

pt-BR.name: Seletivo
pt-BR.description: Se você tem um efeito Anular em Área, este extra permite escolher quem na área é afetado, anulando alguns alvos e não outros.

extras.name: Sustained
extras.description: If this modifier is applied to Concentration Nullify, keeping the countered effect(s) suppressed is only a free action for you each turn.
extras.longDescription: If this modifier is applied to Concentration Nullify, keeping the countered effect(s) suppressed is only a free action for you each turn.

pt-BR.name: Sustentado
pt-BR.description: Se este modificador for aplicado a Anular com Concentração, manter o(s) efeito(s) anulado(s) suprimido(s) é apenas uma ação livre para você a cada turno.

flaws.name: Side Effect
flaws.description: If you fail to nullify an effect, you might suffer some kind of 'backlash' or similar side effect.
flaws.longDescription: If you fail to nullify an effect, you might suffer some kind of 'backlash' or similar side effect.

pt-BR.name: Efeito Colateral
pt-BR.description: Se você falhar em anular um efeito, pode sofrer algum tipo de 'contragolpe' ou efeito colateral similar.

name: Protection
description: Shields you against damage, giving you +1 to your Toughness defense per rank. So Protection 4 gives you +4 Toughness. Can be made Sustained (activatable force field) or Impervious (immune to lower-threshold Damage).

pt-BR.name: Proteção
pt-BR.description: Protege contra dano, concedendo +1 à defesa de Resistência por rank. Proteção 4 concede +4 de Resistência. Pode ser Sustentado (campo de força ativável) ou Impenetrável (imune a Dano abaixo de um limiar).

longDescription: Protection is a flat bonus to Toughness equal to its rank. Unlike armored heroes, Protection is usually an internal power (force field, body armor, toughened skin, etc.). Each rank of Protection improves Toughness by 1. Protection can be stacked with other Toughness bonuses (like natural Stamina). Note: stacked Protection above PL limits is subject to GM approval.

flaws.name: Sustained
flaws.description: Your Protection is a sustained effect, rather than permanent. The effect can be turned on and off and can be improved using extra effort, including using it to perform stunts. Sustained Protection might be a power like a personal force field, or the ability to consciously harden your skin and turn it into armor.
flaws.longDescription: Sustained Protection changes the duration from permanent to sustained. It is a net +0 modifier from Protection's base permanent duration. This allows the effect to be turned on and off, improved with extra effort, and used for power stunts.

pt-BR.name: Sustentado
pt-BR.description: Sua Proteção é um efeito sustentado, ao invés de permanente. O efeito pode ser ligado e desligado e pode ser melhorado usando esforço extra, incluindo usá-lo para realizar truques. Proteção Sustentada pode ser um poder como um campo de força pessoal, ou a habilidade de conscientemente endurecer sua pele e transformá-la em armadura.

name: Quickness
description: You can perform routine tasks fast. Subtract your effect rank from the normal time rank. So Quickness 7 turns a task normally taking 1 hour (time rank 9) into 30 seconds (time rank 2). Does not affect non-routine checks or movement speed. Tasks performed in less than 1 second may be treated as free actions.

pt-BR.name: Rapidez
pt-BR.description: Permite realizar tarefas rotineiras rapidamente. Subtraia seu rank do efeito do rank de tempo normal. Rapidez 7 transforma uma tarefa de 1 hora (rank de tempo 9) em 30 segundos (rank de tempo 2). Não afeta testes não-rotineiros nem velocidade de movimento. Tarefas realizadas em menos de 1 segundo podem ser tratadas como ações livres.

longDescription: You can perform routine tasks fast. Subtract your effect rank from the normal time rank. So Quickness 7 turns a task normally taking 1 hour (time rank 9) into 30 seconds (time rank 2). Does not affect non-routine checks or movement speed. Tasks performed in less than 1 second may be treated as free actions.

flaws.name: Limited to One Type
flaws.description: Your Quickness applies to only physical or mental tasks, not both.
flaws.longDescription: Your Quickness applies to only physical or mental tasks, not both. This limits the versatility of the effect significantly.

pt-BR.name: Limitado a Um Tipo
pt-BR.description: Sua Rapidez se aplica apenas a tarefas físicas ou mentais, não ambas.

flaws.name: Limited to One Task
flaws.description: Your Quickness applies to only one particular task, such as reading, mathematical calculations, and so forth.
flaws.longDescription: Your Quickness applies to only one particular task, such as reading, mathematical calculations, and so forth. This severely limits the effect to a very narrow application.

pt-BR.name: Limitado a Uma Tarefa
pt-BR.description: Sua Rapidez se aplica apenas a uma tarefa específica, como leitura, cálculos matemáticos, etc.

name: Regeneration
description: You recover quickly from damage. Remove Toughness check penalties equal to your rank each minute, then recover other damage conditions equal to rank each minute (spread evenly over 10 rounds). Regeneration 5: remove -1 penalty every other round. Regeneration 10: every round. Characters with no Stamina need at least 1 rank to recover at normal rate.

pt-BR.name: Regeneração
pt-BR.description: Recupera-se rapidamente de dano. Remove penalidades de testes de Resistência iguais ao seu rank a cada minuto, depois recupera outras condições de dano iguais ao rank a cada minuto (distribuídas em 10 rodadas). Regeneração 5: remove -1 a cada 2 rodadas. Regeneração 10: a cada rodada. Personagens sem Vigor precisam de ao menos 1 rank para se recuperar normalmente.

longDescription: You recover quickly from damage. Remove Toughness check penalties equal to your rank each minute, then recover other damage conditions equal to rank each minute (spread evenly over 10 rounds). Regeneration 5: remove -1 penalty every other round. Regeneration 10: every round. Characters with no Stamina need at least 1 rank to recover at normal rate.

name: Remote Sensing
description: You can displace one or more senses over a distance. Rank 1 = 60 feet, increasing one distance rank per rank. Overrides normal senses while active; you are vulnerable. Subjects feel it with Insight check (DC 10 + rank). Cost: 1 pt/rank for one sense type, 2 for two, 3 for three, 4 for four, 5 for all (visual = 2 types).

pt-BR.name: Sensoriamento Remoto
pt-BR.description: Permite deslocar um ou mais sentidos à distância. Rank 1 = 18 m, aumentando um rank de distância por rank. Substitui os sentidos normais enquanto ativo; você fica vulnerável. Alvos sentem com teste de Intuição (CD 10 + rank). Custo: 1 pp/rank para um tipo de sentido, 2 para dois, 3 para três, 4 para quatro, 5 para todos (visual = 2 tipos).

longDescription: You can displace one or more senses over a distance. Rank 1 = 60 feet, increasing one distance rank per rank. Overrides normal senses while active; you are vulnerable. Subjects feel it with Insight check (DC 10 + rank). Cost: 1 pt/rank for one sense type, 2 for two, 3 for three, 4 for four, 5 for all (visual = 2 types).

extras.name: Dimensional
extras.description: Sense into other dimensions.

pt-BR.name: Dimensional
pt-BR.description: Percebe em outras dimensões.

extras.name: Simultaneous
extras.description: Use normal senses and Remote Sensing at the same time.

pt-BR.name: Simultâneo
pt-BR.description: Usa sentidos normais e remotos ao mesmo tempo.

extras.name: Subtle
extras.description: Harder to notice (1 rank) or undetectable (2 ranks).

pt-BR.name: Sutil
pt-BR.description: Mais difícil de notar ou indetectável.

flaws.name: Feedback
flaws.description: Damaging attacks at the remote location can affect you.

pt-BR.name: Retroalimentação
pt-BR.description: Ataques no local remoto podem te afetar.

flaws.name: Medium
flaws.description: Requires a medium (e.g., mirrors, water).

pt-BR.name: Meio
pt-BR.description: Exige um meio (ex: espelhos, água).

flaws.name: Noticeable
flaws.description: Has a noticeable manifestation (e.g., glowing eyes).

pt-BR.name: Perceptível
pt-BR.description: Possui uma manifestação visível.

name: Senses
description: One or more of your senses are improved or you have additional sensory abilities. Allocate ranks to: Accurate (2/4), Acute (1/2), Analytical (1/2), Awareness (1), Communication Link (1), Counters Concealment (2/5), Counters Illusion (2), Danger Sense (1), Darkvision (2), Detect (1/2), Direction Sense (1), Distance Sense (1), Extended (1+), Infravision (1), Low-Light Vision (1), Microscopic Vision (1-4), Penetrates Concealment (4), Postcognition (4), Precognition (4), Radio (1), Radius (1/2), Ranged (1), Rapid (1+), Time Sense (1), Tracking (1/2), Ultra-Hearing (1), Ultravision (1).

pt-BR.name: Sentidos
pt-BR.description: Um ou mais de seus sentidos são aprimorados ou você possui habilidades sensoriais adicionais.
